caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded clay pot placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pot is made of a brown material with darker speckling throughout its surface and has a glossy finish that reflects light in several places, indicating its smooth texture. The vessel features a prominent rim at the top that gently flares outward, a short, slightly tapered neck, and a bulbous body that curves inward as it approaches the narrow, flat base. There is a subtle horizontal ridge encircling the pot near the top portion of the body. At the bottom right corner of the image, the artist's signature, "N. Amantea," appears in small, neat handwriting.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
